claims: Carlos Ulberg is the reigning UFC Light Heavyweight Champion.
Carlos Ulberg defeated Jiří Procházka via first-round knockout at UFC 327 on April 11, 2026, in Miami.
Carlos Ulberg injured his knee in the opening minute.
Carlos Ulberg secured the vacant UFC Light Heavyweight title with a counter left hook.
Carlos Ulberg won the UFC Light Heavyweight title at UFC 327 on April 11, 2026.
Carlos Ulberg defeated Jiří Procházka by TKO (punch) at 3:45 of Round 1.
Jiří Procházka was Carlos Ulberg's opponent.
The UFC Light Heavyweight title became vacant after former champion Alex Pereira vacated the belt.
Alex Pereira vacated the UFC Light Heavyweight belt to move up to the heavyweight division.
